title: Learn To Talk With Me - Videos
description:
Helping your child learn to communicate doesn’t have to be stressful.

Learn an easier, no-pressure way in my new short course: https://stan.store/learntotalkwithme/p/learn-to-talk-with-me-toddler

I Can Say Bye-Bye! —my new book that helps your child say “hi” and “bye-bye” with lift-the-flap fun is out February 4th! Click below to buy 🍪 

https://www.learntotalkwithme.com/books

Toy & Book Guides (by age)- developmental learning toy and book recommendations from a baby & toddler expert:
https://www.learntotalkwithme.com/toyguides

I’m a speech-language pathologist & mom of 3 here to help babies & toddlers talk and eat. Here to share with you my favorite toys, books, and tips for helping little ones learn to talk. I will also share with you my very favorite tips for helping your little one learn to enjoy eating and participate in mealtimes with your family! Check out my bestselling board book series, the My First Learn-to-Talk books!
